findings.actual_failure: A worker in an open attempt can append canonical gh-resolved lines, which are stripped and so not refused, until each attempt check takes minutes, so the run neither refuses nor admits in useful time.
findings.observation: _strip_tracking_blocks walks back from each gh-resolved line through every earlier member line to its remote header, so N gh-resolved lines cost order N squared regex matches (measured: 2000, 4000, 8000 lines took 0.18 s, 0.72 s, 2.81 s).
findings.reachable_path: _supervisor_attempt.py _strip_tracking_blocks via git_state from guard, _differences, launched and _control_check before every hardened Git call

findings.actual_failure: A controller that follows the guidance and runs gh pr merge 123 or gh pr checks 123 without --repo can act on a repository a worker chose through an unrefused gh-resolved line, so the accepted-risk condition does not hold.
findings.observation: references/supervisor.md says each excluded key steers only a bare git push, git pull or argument-less gh pr command, but remote.<name>.gh-resolved sets the base repository for every gh command run without --repo.
findings.reachable_path: packs/core/.apm/skills/work-loop/references/supervisor.md External effects paragraph read by the controller

findings.actual_failure: A mutation that drops every hookspath line under [core] makes a core.hooksPath change invisible to the digest and all 106 tests still pass.
findings.observation: The AC-0002 code-running cases compare a file that also carries an extra section header against BASE, so the leftover header alone makes the fingerprints differ.

findings.actual_failure: Each of those four mutations passes all 106 tests, so a regression could strip a shape Git reads as a live key, e.g. a tab-indented [core] header before gh-resolved.
findings.observation: Four canonical-form rules have no keep-case: header-only branch blocks, _MEMBER_LINE tab-plus-lowercase, control bytes in _TRACKING_VALUE, and backslash or control bytes in subsection classes.

findings.actual_failure: AC-0016 gets no check on the Windows job while the zero-skip gate passes, and a dropped kind on Linux would be equally invisible.
findings.observation: On Windows _special_cases() returns an empty list so the link/special test is never defined, and the guard probes TMPDIR while the fifo is made under tmp_path.

findings.actual_failure: An operator facing common:config cannot tell whether a sibling tracking write under a raw-form manifest or a real config change caused it, so the restore instruction cannot be acted on without guesswork.
findings.observation: A config-caused refusal says the entry label and 'restore these paths' but neither the detail nor .refused.json records which form (config-view or raw) the entry was recorded in.

findings.actual_failure: A reader is told config entries are size-and-sha256 when they now record config-view fingerprints.
findings.observation: The module docstring says every Git control state file is recorded as size and sha256.

findings.actual_failure: The comment about the Windows confined-write checker now heads the config-fingerprint step.
findings.observation: The new build-check.yml step sits between an existing comment and the JUnit checker step that comment describes.

findings.actual_failure: Any detail containing config passes, including config.worktree, so the wrong label would not fail the test.
findings.observation: The VI-0109 refused branch asserts only the substring config.

findings.actual_failure: With TMPDIR set to a missing directory the VI-0115 fifo case is not collected while VI-0122 passes, so AC-0016's special-file check drops out with no skip for the zero-skip gate to see.
findings.observation: _special_cases() still gates fifo on a TMPDIR existence probe, and VI-0122 never compares the per-platform expected kinds with the kinds VI-0115 collects; its last two asserts compare constants.

findings.actual_failure: An operator may read a non-canonical tracking-key edit as allowed and not undo it.
findings.observation: The attempt-residue row says 'A config-view path changed outside a tracking block: undo that change', but a non-canonical tracking write also refuses.

findings.actual_failure: Reverting either line to drop the mark leaves the suite green, so the refusal an operator sees after next can lose the mark the reference tells them to act on.
findings.observation: The recorded-form mark in the standing attempt-residue detail and the denied-git-control-state detail is not pinned by any test.
